halo2014-semc-mean-and-snapshot-depths-v.source_forcing_context: Climatological COADS05 surface forcing and WOA05 lateral boundaries; model years have no assigned Gregorian dates.
halo2014-semc-mean-and-snapshot-depths-v.identity_mapping: Source SEMC/EastMadagascar maps to existing current:southern-east-madagascar per previously admitted Ponsoni identity association. SICC,EMUC and bottom western boundary flow excluded.
halo2014-semc-mean-and-snapshot-depths-v.excluded_descriptors: SICC is South Indian Ocean Countercurrent at subtropical latitudes,not automatically accepted Indian South Equatorial Countercurrent. No silent identity mapping. ASCLME isopycnal1500m suggestion is hydrographic corroboration,not new measured velocity bottom; ADCP sampled only upper300m. Secondary Nauw depth comparisons not independently extracted. Model eddies not named real eddies.
halo2014-semc-mean-and-snapshot-depths-v.model_limits: Model underrepresents EastMadagascarUndercurrent at25S; mean SEMC depth differs from comparison hydrography. At45E model intensities about50percent low relative to cited observations. No numerical depth uncertainty inferred.
halo2014-semc-mean-and-snapshot-depths-v.review_access: Primary full publisher HTML available;selected Methods2.3/2.5,Results3.2 and Figure9discussion and captions reviewed. No figure pixels,source-byte hash,PDF,native model archive or supplement acquired. Review completed;no reopen for these quantities.
halo2014-semc-mean-and-snapshot-depths-v.rights: Six short excerpt words;citation and factual paraphrases only,no article or figure redistribution.
